title: Pair of Vintage Raimond Silverplate Wine Goblets – Made in Italy – 7" Tall
descriptionText:
This listing is for a pair of vintage Raimond silverplate wine goblets, made in Italy. Raimond is well-known for its elegant silverplate tableware, and these goblets are a beautiful example of their craftsmanship.
Brand/Marking: Raimond Silverplate, Italy (engraved on base)
Material: Silverplate
Dimensions (approx.):
Height: 7 inches (17.8 cm)
Rim diameter: 3 inches (7.6 cm)
Condition: Pre-owned vintage condition. They show natural tarnish and patina from age (can be polished to shine if desired). No dents, cracks, or major damage observed. Please see photos for details.
These goblets are perfect for collectors of silverplate, vintage Italian barware, or elegant dining décor. They can be used functionally as wine goblets or displayed as decorative pieces.
